seo.title: The Luttrell · Furnished student rooms on Channing Way, Berkeley
seo.description: Furnished private and shared rooms at 2328 Channing Way, Berkeley. About five minutes on foot to campus. Now leasing Spring and Fall 2027.

hero.alt: The Luttrell at 2328 Channing Way: the restored 1889 yellow Victorian house with the new five-story building behind it.

intro.headline: Furnished rooms, five minutes from campus.
intro.body: The Luttrell is at 2328 Channing Way: private rooms and shared rooms, in thirteen apartments and one historic house. The front house was built in 1889 for Captain James F. and Cecilia M. Luttrell.

image.alt: Illustration of the Luttrell House and the new building behind it, drawn from a photo of the real building.

intro.caption: Channing Way, 1889 & now

rooms.heading: Floor plans
rooms.body: Every room comes furnished. A private room has a full bed, desk, chair, two 2-drawer chests and a wardrobe. A shared room has two Twin XL beds, two desks and chairs, and two wardrobes.

image.alt: Furnished floor plan, Layout 1: kitchen with dining table, bathroom with tub, shared Bedroom 1 with two twin beds and desks, private Bedroom 2 with a full bed and desk.
Furnished floor plan, Layout 2: kitchen with dining table, bathroom with tub, shared Bedroom 1 with two twin beds and desks, private Bedroom 2 with a full bed and desk.
Furnished floor plan, Layout 3: kitchen with dining table, bathroom with tub, study nook, and three private bedrooms, each with a full bed, desk and wardrobe.
Furnished floor plan, Layout 4: kitchen and dining area, two bathrooms with tubs, and four private bedrooms, each with a full bed, desk and wardrobe.

Furnished floor plans of the Luttrell House. First floor: entry, stairs, Bedroom 1, Bath 1, kitchen, living and dining. Second floor: shared Bedroom 2 with two twin beds, Bedrooms 3 and 4, Baths 2 and 3.

rooms.note: Fall 2027 monthly rates. Shared-bedroom pricing is per person in a two-person bedroom. Spring specials available.
